headline: Wall Street me badi girawat, Nasdaq 5.5% gira
detail: America ke share bazaar me 5 November ko badi girawat aayi; Nasdaq 5.52% gira aur correction me chala gaya, jabki S&P 500 4.36% aur Dow 3.44% gira.
exam_angle: America ki arthvyavastha aur share bazaar — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Bank of England ne byaj dar 4% ki
detail: Bank of England ne byaj dar 3.75% se badha kar 4% kar di, teen saal me pehli badhotri; MPC ne 8-1 se faisla liya aur mahangai ke 5% tak jaane ka anumaan lagaya.
exam_angle: Kendriya bank aur byaj dar — banking aur arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: KOSPI 8% gira, circuit breaker laga
detail: South Korea ka KOSPI subah ke karobar me 8% se zyada gira aur 5,000 ke neeche chala gaya, jisse 20 minute ke liye karobar roka gaya; Samsung aur SK hynix ke share bhi buri tarah gire.
exam_angle: Asia ke share bazaar aur AI stock girawat — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Turkey ne teen-desh raksha samjhauta manzoor kiya
detail: Turkey ki sansad ne Saudi Arabia aur Pakistan ke saath Mecca raksha samjhaute ko 279 ke muqable 119 maton se manzoor kiya; samjhaute ke tahat ek desh par hamla teeno par hamla mana jayega.
exam_angle: Samoohik raksha aur paschim Asia ki suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Serbia me chhatra andolan ko 140 seatein
detail: Serbia ke chunav aayog ne antim natije ghoshit kiye; chhatra andolan ki Student List ko 250 me se 140 seatein mili jabki Vucic ki party ko 103 seatein mili, aur 14 saal ka shasan khatm ho gaya.
exam_angle: Chhatra andolan se sarkar badlav — loktantra aur Europe ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Saudi ne Pakistan ko $3 billion ki madad badhai
detail: Saudi Arabia ne Pakistan ke liye $3 billion ki vittiya suvidha ko uchit avadhi ke liye badha diya; vitt mantri Muhammad Aurangzeb ne sansad ke bahar iski pushti ki, jabki alag $5 billion ki suvidha 2028 tak badhi hui hai.
exam_angle: IMF aur videshi mudra bhandar — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: US midterms me Democrats ki badi jeet
detail: America ke midterm chunav me Democrats ne Senate aur House dono par kabza kar liya; 7 Senate seatein palti aur Michigan se Abdul El-Sayed desh ke pehle Muslim senator chune gaye.
exam_angle: America ki vibhajit sarkar aur 2028 ki daud — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Paraguay rashtrapati ne bank sankat par istifa diya
detail: Paraguay ke Rashtrapati Santiago Peña ne Ueno Bank ke dhahne ke baad istifa de diya; bank ke lagbhag 30 lakh grahakon ke khate band ho gaye aur unpar aapradhik jaanch aur mahabhiyog ki karyavahi shuru hui.
exam_angle: Bank niyaman aur rashtrapati ki jawabdehi — banking aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Brooklyn me aag, 6 ki maut
detail: New York ke Brooklyn me ek ghar me lagi aag me 6 logon ki maut ho gayi aur 9 ghayal hue, jinme 3 firefighter aur 2 police adhikari shamil hain; aag ke kaaran ki jaanch chal rahi hai.

headline: Eisenkot ko 67 samarthan, Netanyahu peeche
detail: Israel me Yashar neta Gadi Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ke liye 67 sansadon ka samarthan mila, jabki Netanyahu ko 46 mile; Rashtrapati Herzog Ravivar ko faisla karenge.
exam_angle: Israel ki sansadiya vyavastha aur sarkar gathan — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: FATF ki scam compounds par badi report
detail: FATF ne scam compounds se jude avaidh vittiya pravah par nayi report jaari ki; har saal dasyon arab dollar ka nuksan hota hai aur lagbhag 120 case studies me 60 se zyada kshetron ko shamil kiya gaya.
exam_angle: FATF, money laundering aur cyber dhokhadhadi — banking aur arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.
